user_boundaries: 0.8-1.0 MHz, start 0.9 MHz, nominal port 100 Vpp, hard 160 Vpp; 5 mA interpreted as RMS by assumption
current_limit_measurement_point: transducer_port, where the user 5 mA RMS upper limit is measured (confirmed by the user 2026-10-16); this historical regression configuration has its 5 mA design point on that limit and 5.5/6.0 mA soft/hard limits above it; amplifier output current is not subject to the limit and is reported only
user_current_limit_rule: user upper limit on the RMS current at the transducer port, the same point as current_soft_Arms/current_hard_Arms (measurement point confirmed by the user 2026-10-16); every execution row after the guard is checked against it and reported per strategy; it does not change the guard limits
scan_budget_origin: declared_not_tuned; every class is bounded and any exhaustion reaches the same latch; rationale and the sensitivity that is NOT established in review/13
phase_centre_recovery_rule: when true: after an accepted changed centre, no new phase update until two consecutive NORMAL, unfrozen 20 ms CONTROL samples at the new centre show the same applied amplitude; off in this default configuration (review/23 per-trial pre-guard current-peak rule fails on the Qm=800 baseline, 13/31)
phase_tracker_rule: gain_v1 = the original law: input phase arg(V_input/I_source), target frozen at the 0.9 MHz baseline calibration, step = phase_gain_Hz_per_deg x error, probes +-phase_probe_offset_Hz; it accepts only phase_signal input with phase_target_policy frozen. newton_v2: step = phase_newton_fraction x error / measured slope, clipped to phase_max_step_per_width x peak width, probes +-max(phase_probe_offset_Hz, phase_probe_offset_per_width x width), target learned from the first valid CONTROL sample; phase_signal port = arg(V_port/I_port) at the transducer terminals; relearn_after_capture re-learns the target at the point each power-drop-triggered capture chooses, frozen never captures
capture_scan_rule: started only by a measured power drop (capture_scan_drop_fraction below the learned reference for drop_confirm_samples comparable samples), never on a timer and never at t=0; anchor, remembered points first, then a coarse pass over the whole band, refinement at 1/capture_scan_refine_factor of the step over +-1 previous step until the step is below capture_scan_refine_step_per_width x the measured half-power width or reaches capture_scan_min_step_Hz, a second local maximum within capture_scan_secondary_peak_ratio refined too, anchor re-measured after every level, final validation, and no move unless the winner beats the anchor by capture_scan_gain_threshold; dwell = clip(capture_scan_settle_time_constants/(pi x width), capture_scan_dwell_min_us, scan_point_us); all points at capture_scan_amplitude = voltage_soft_Vpp/(2 x 100 Vpp); failures use the scan budgets and latch above; nominal_peak_width_Hz is the design point's loaded P_Rm half-power width, used until a capture measures one
po_rule: CAPTURE_PO: two-sided perturb-and-observe on the measured soft-feasible power; each comparison probes f_op -+ step and moves only to a side that beats the mean of the recent CONTROL samples by po_move_threshold (or noise_sigmas measured difference sigmas, if larger); a move grows the step by po_grow, a comparison without one shrinks it by po_shrink, within [po_step_min_per_width, po_step_max_per_width] x peak width, starting at po_step_initial_per_width x width; po_park_comparisons comparisons at the minimum step without a move park it until the power monitor reports a change; a confirmed drop goes to recall and then the capture scan described in capture_scan_rule
